description: This Java class, DefaultConnectionMetricsCounter, implements the ConnectionMetricsCounter interface and functions as a helper class to collect various connection metrics, such as success and failure counts, producing measurements, and providing string representations and equality checks. It is part of a monitoring and metrics framework within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically for tracking connection-related metrics across messaging interfaces.

classes.name: DefaultConnectionMetricsCounter
classes.description: A final class implementing ConnectionMetricsCounter, designed to record and report connection success/failure metrics, including counters, timestamps, and measurement conversion.

methods.name: recordSuccess
methods.description: Increments the success counter and logs the action.

methods.name: recordFailure
methods.description: Increments the failure counter and logs the action.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the counter and logs the action.

methods.name: getMetricType
methods.description: Returns the MetricType associated with this counter.

methods.name: getMetricDirection
methods.description: Returns the MetricDirection indicating the direction of the connection.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns the address associated with this counter.

methods.name: toMeasurement
methods.description: Produces a Measurement object summarizing current metrics with an optional timestamp.

methods.name: getLastMessageTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the last success or failure measurement.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on metric direction, address, metric type, and counter.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the core fields of the object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the object.
